segments.titleJa: シガンシナへのルート
segments.ja: 第五十七回の壁外調査が残したのは、シガンシナ区へ続くルートではありません。エレンが遠征に求めていたのは、落ちた壁の向こうへ戻る一歩でした。森のあとに残ったのは一歩ではなく、鉄槌です。調査兵団は壁の内側へ戻り、外の目標は昨日と同じ場所にあります。距離は縮みません。縮んだのは、馬の数と、隣にいる兵士の数です。今日は、塞ぐべき穴さえ残っていません。
segments.en: What the 57th expedition left behind was not a route on toward Shiganshina District. Eren had wanted one step back past the fallen wall. After the forest, what remained was a crushing blow. The Survey Corps came back inside the walls, and the outside goal has not moved. The distance did not shrink. The number of horses did, and the number of soldiers beside him. Today there is not even a hole left to close.

segments.ja: 女型の巨人を、巨人の種類として片づけることは、もうできません。種類なら、恐れれば足ります。今日の敵は人間です。中身があり、装備を理解し、調査兵団の動きに合わせて襲ってきました。エレンはその事実を、森の暗さより重く受け取ります。怪物なら、刃を入れる理由は簡単です。人間なら、理由の前に選択が来ます。種類の欄は、空欄のまま次の頁へ送られます。
segments.en: The Female Titan can no longer be filed away as a kind of Titan. A kind is something you only have to fear. Today's enemy is human. There is a person inside, someone who understood the gear and attacked in time with the Survey Corps' movements. Eren takes that fact as heavier than the dark of the forest. If it were a monster, the reason for a blade would be simple. A human puts a choice in front of the reason. The type field is sent on to the next page still blank.

segments.ja: リヴァイはエレンを中身として壁の内側まで運びました。女型の巨人の中身は、捕獲できないまま逃げています。同じ言葉が、守る対象と止める対象の両方に使われます。エレンは自分の体が回収されたことに感謝し、相手の中身を取り逃がしたことに拒否を感じます。兵長はその気持ちを整理しません。必要だったのは気持ちではなく、次の刃の位置です。二つの中身を同じ語で呼ぶことが、鉄槌の芯です。
segments.en: Levi carried Eren, as contents, back inside the walls. The contents of the Female Titan escaped, still not captured. The same word covers what you protect and what you have to stop. Eren is grateful that his own body was recovered, and he refuses the fact that the other contents got away. The Captain does not sort those feelings. What was necessary was not a feeling. It was the place of the next blade. Calling both contents by one word is the core of the blow.

segments.ja: 立体機動装置の基本は、変わっていません。接近し、うなじを刃で断つ。兵士なら誰でも言う手順です。エレンは今日、その手順を人間の体の話として聞き直します。うなじの下にいるのは、空腹の巨人だけではありません。選択を持った誰かです。刃が遅れたのは、技術の不足だけではない、と彼は思います。遅れた理由に、相手を人間と認めた瞬間がありました。装備の手順は短く、認めることのほうが長いです。
segments.en: The basics of ODM gear have not changed. Close in, and cut the nape with the blade. Any soldier can say the steps. Today Eren hears those steps again as a statement about a human body. Under the nape there is not only a hungry Titan. There is someone with a choice. He thinks the late blade was not only a lack of skill. Inside the lateness there was a moment when he admitted the opponent was human. The steps of the gear are short. Admitting the person takes longer.

segments.ja: 鉄槌が残した名前は、グンターとエルドだけではありません。オルオも、ペトラも、もう列にいません。エレンは仲間の名を、作戦の失敗の説明に使いたくありません。それでも名は、選択が抽象ではなかった証拠として残ります。誰かが立っていた場所に、敵の速度が先に着きました。全速力でも、本部が描いた線でも、その着順は覆りません。覆らないことを、彼はようやく数として見ます。数は、哀悼の代わりにはなりません。
segments.en: The names the blow left are not only Gunther and Eld. Oluo is gone from the column too, and so is Petra. Eren does not want to use his comrades' names as an explanation of a failed operation. The names still remain as proof that the choice was not abstract. The enemy's speed arrived first at a place where someone was standing. Full speed did not reverse that order, and neither did the line drawn at headquarters. He finally looks at what cannot be reversed as a count. A count does not stand in for mourning.

segments.en: Eren replays the fight as a row of choices. Where was the mistake. The moment titanization came late. The moment he misread the Female Titan's muscle. The moment he thought the opponent would stop. He stays longest on the last of these. The hope that the human inside would quit the fight the way one of his own would. That hope was right for a comrade and wrong for an enemy. By the time he can see the mistake, the crushing blow has already landed. That hope protects comrades, and it is a gap in front of an enemy.

segments.en: Resolve is not a louder voice. It is deciding, when capture has failed, to put the blade into an enemy who has a human shape. Eren does not like this word. A word he does not like was necessary today. Levi's standard is short. Stop them if you can. If you cannot, cut the nape. The standard is cold, and it exists to keep more soldiers alive. On a day when it could not, only the standard remains. That remainder is set down as the first line of the next operation.

segments.ja: 森の作戦は、その場の最善策として組まれていました。本部は全速力の襲撃と、女型の巨人の捕獲を同じ図に置いています。最善は、成功の約束ではありません。失敗した最善策が体に残すものが、鉄槌です。エレンは図の正しさと、結果の死者を、同時に持て余します。正しい図が人を返すなら、今日の列はもっと長いはずでした。図は人を返しません。返すのは、次の図だけです。次の図は、森ではなく人の名で描かれます。
segments.en: The forest operation had been built as the best plan available there. Headquarters put a full-speed assault and the capture of the Female Titan on the same diagram. Best is not a promise of success. What a failed best plan leaves in the body is a crushing blow. Eren cannot hold the diagram's correctness and the dead result at the same time. If a correct diagram returned people, today's column would be longer. A diagram does not return people. Only the next diagram does. The next one will be drawn with a person's name, not with the forest.

segments.ja: 作戦が求めたのは、仕留めることより捕獲です。死んだ敵は、壁の内側の質問に答えません。誰が情報を渡し、誰が女型の巨人に入っていたか。その答えは、中身が生きていなければ取れません。一方で、仕留めそこねた時間に仲間は死にました。捕獲の価値と、遅れた刃の代償は、どちらも本物です。エレンは片方を選んで楽になることを、兵長が許さないと分かっています。両方を持つことが、兵長のあとについていく条件です。
segments.en: The operation wanted capture more than a finished kill. A dead enemy answers no question from inside the walls. Who passed the information. Who was inside the Female Titan. That answer cannot be taken unless the contents are alive. In the time the kill was missed, comrades died. The worth of capture and the price of a late blade are both real. Eren knows the Captain will not let him become comfortable by picking only one. Holding both is the condition of following the Captain.

segments.ja: エレンがまだ信じられるのは、リヴァイと、ミカサと、列に残った仲間です。信じる範囲は、制服を着た全員には届きません。女型の巨人が壊したのは、その第二の信じ方です。壁の中の人間は味方だ、という前提。前提が落ちると、次の作戦は森の外ではなく、人の顔のあいだで始まります。エレンは顔を疑う作業に、刃より強い疲れを感じます。疲れは、疑わなくてよい理由にはなりません。顔を見る作業は、壁の内側でこれから始まります。
segments.en: What Eren can still trust is Levi, Mikasa, and the comrades left in the column. Trust does not reach everyone in a uniform. What the Female Titan broke was that second kind of belief. The assumption that a human inside the walls is an ally. When the assumption falls, the next operation starts not outside the forest but between faces. Eren feels a deeper tiredness in suspecting faces than in using a blade. Tired is not a reason he may stop suspecting. The work of looking at faces is about to begin inside the walls.

segments.ja: 巨人化は、筋肉と速度をエレンに返します。今日は、その返却が遅れました。遅れた体は、本人には神経の失敗に感じられます。まわりから見れば、それも選択の一種です。女型の巨人の筋肉は、こちらの判断より先に動きました。エレンは自分の拳が、必要な瞬間に世界へ出てこなかったことを覚えています。覚えたまま、次は遅れないと言い切れません。言い切るには、相手が誰でも刃を入れる覚悟が要ります。遅れを約束で消すことは、まだできません。
segments.en: Titanization gives Eren back muscle and speed. Today the return came late. A late body feels, to him, like a failure of nerve. Seen from the side, it is also a kind of choice. The Female Titan's muscle moved ahead of their decision. Eren remembers that his fist did not enter the world at the moment it was needed. Remembering it, he still cannot promise that next time he will not be late. A promise needs the resolve to use the blade no matter who the opponent is. He still cannot erase the lateness with a promise.

segments.ja: ミカサは、エレンの選択の端に立っています。彼が動けないなら、彼女が動く。エレンはその配置を知っていて、知っていることが新しい重荷です。誰かの準備は、自分の覚悟の代わりになりません。代わりになると感じた瞬間に、鉄槌は仲間へ移ります。彼はミカサを守るために巨人になり、ミカサに守られるために刃が遅れる。その循環を、今日は断つ側に回らなければなりません。循環を断つ側に立つことが、次の選択です。
segments.en: Mikasa stands at the edge of Eren's choice. If he cannot move, she will. He knows that arrangement, and knowing it is a new weight. Someone else's readiness does not replace his resolve. The moment it feels like a replacement, the crushing blow moves onto a comrade. He becomes a Titan to protect Mikasa, and the blade comes late because she protects him. Today he has to stand on the side that breaks that circle. Standing there is the next choice.

A soldier's job is to look at the nape while knowing a face is inside. If you stop the blade by using the word human as a shield, a different human dies where you stopped. Unlike the day he stopped Titans at Trost District, today's enemy does not wear a face that came from outside the city. The face resembles their own column. The day of treating a similar face as an enemy is getting closer.

segments.en: The crushing blow is not only one strike from a Titan's fist. It is the shape of the retreat itself. Capture failed. The assault, even as the best plan, did not arrive. The route to Shiganshina lost its straight line. From the top of the wall, the expedition looks as if it came home. From inside the column, the way home is a report of failure. Eren starts writing that report from his own lateness. The Captain does not let him. What is needed next is to be ready to call an unnamed enemy by a name. The preparation is still stopped in front of that name.

segments.en: Today's words. A crushing blow is the weight a failed best plan leaves in the body. Contents means the human inside the Female Titan, and also Eren, who was recovered. The nape is where a blade touches a human. The choice sits between capture and finishing it. Resolve is not running from that choice. The Female Titan was not captured. The opponent's name is not set down today. The next operation starts where a name gets set down. The weight of the name not yet set down is the rest of the blow.

The Female Titan's muscle moved ahead of their decision. Eren remembers that his fist did not enter the world at the moment it was needed. Remembering it, he still cannot promise that next time he will not be late. A promise needs the resolve to use the blade no matter who the opponent is. He still cannot erase the lateness with a promise.

vocab.exampleJa: 前提が落ちると、次の作戦は森の外ではなく、人の顔のあいだで始まります。
vocab.exampleEn: What Eren can still trust is Levi, Mikasa, and the comrades left in the column. Trust does not reach everyone in a uniform. When the assumption falls, the next operation starts not outside the forest but between faces. Eren feels a deeper tiredness in suspecting faces than in using a blade. Tired is not a reason he may stop suspecting. The work of looking at faces is about to begin inside the walls.

vocab.exampleJa: その期待は仲間には正しく、敵には間違いでした。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren replays the fight as a row of choices. Where was the mistake. The moment titanization came late. The moment he misread the Female Titan's muscle. The moment he thought the opponent would stop. He stays longest on the last of these. The hope that the human inside would quit the fight the way one of his own would. That hope was right for a comrade and wrong for an enemy. By the time he can see the mistake, the crushing blow has already landed. That hope protects comrades, and it is a gap in front of an enemy.

vocab.exampleJa: 壁の上から見れば、遠征は帰ってきたように見えます。

Eren starts writing that report from his own lateness. The Captain does not let him. What is needed next is to be ready to call an unnamed enemy by a name. The preparation is still stopped in front of that name.

vocab.exampleEn: Levi carried Eren, as contents, back inside the walls. The contents of the Female Titan escaped, still not captured. The same word covers what you protect and what you have to stop. Eren does not want to use his comrades' names as an explanation of a failed operation. The names still remain as proof that the choice was not abstract. The enemy's speed arrived first at a place where someone was standing. Full speed did not reverse that order, and neither did the line drawn at headquarters. He finally looks at what cannot be reversed as a count. A count does not stand in for mourning.

vocab.exampleJa: エレンが遠征に求めていたのは、落ちた壁の向こうへ戻る一歩でした。
vocab.exampleEn: What the 57th expedition left behind was not a route on toward Shiganshina District. Eren had wanted one step back past the fallen wall. After the forest, what remained was a crushing blow. The Survey Corps came back inside the walls, and the outside goal has not moved. The distance did not shrink. The number of horses did, and the number of soldiers beside him. Today there is not even a hole left to close.

vocab.exampleJa: 最善は、成功の約束ではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: The forest operation had been built as the best plan available there. Headquarters put a full-speed assault and the capture of the Female Titan on the same diagram. Best is not a promise of success. What a failed best plan leaves in the body is a crushing blow. Eren cannot hold the diagram's correctness and the dead result at the same time. If a correct diagram returned people, today's column would be longer. A diagram does not return people. Only the next diagram does. The next one will be drawn with a person's name, not with the forest.

vocab.exampleJa: 人間なら、理由の前に選択が来ます。
vocab.exampleEn: The Female Titan can no longer be filed away as a kind of Titan. A kind is something you only have to fear. Today's enemy is human. There is a person inside, someone who understood the gear and attacked in time with the Survey Corps' movements. Eren takes that fact as heavier than the dark of the forest. If it were a monster, the reason for a blade would be simple. A human puts a choice in front of the reason. The type field is sent on to the next page still blank.

vocab.exampleJa: 同じ言葉が、守る対象と止める対象の両方に使われます。
vocab.exampleEn: Levi carried Eren, as contents, back inside the walls. The contents of the Female Titan escaped, still not captured. The same word covers what you protect and what you have to stop. Eren is grateful that his own body was recovered, and he refuses the fact that the other contents got away. The Captain does not sort those feelings. What was necessary was not a feeling. It was the place of the next blade. Calling both contents by one word is the core of the blow.
